name: kvs-sigma
features: Scans the episode library and offers shuffle clips, random episodes and seasons modes.
Clip length picks 15 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute or 2 minutes.
Play, pause, next, back 10 seconds, forward 30 seconds and start over work.
Full episode plays the current episode from the start, and the bar seeks.
Rescan library rebuilds the episode list.
